thread:
oncall-bot: ALERT: paging /prod/embeddings-high-latency triggered by latency-monitor at 22:07 UTC. 95p token latency > 900ms for 5m. Relevant svc: embeddings-prod, route: /v1/embeddings. Incident ID: INC-2026-87
Liam: got the page, looking now. primary oncall for APAC tonight. Maria if you can be backup for the next hour?
Maria: I can. Primary -> Liam, secondary -> Maria. I'm on vpn and can jump in.
Sam: noted customer-visible timeouts reported by SRE-ops ticket. forwarding the customer email to the thread.
Nina: quick check — any recent deploy to embeddings-prod in the last 2 hours?
Liam: no deploys. checking autoscaler and recent kernel OOM events.
oncall-bot: stack-trace snippets found in logs-service: multiple `205` error lines for grpc timeouts. See: https://internal-logs/redwood/embeddings-prod?query=grpc%20timeout
Liam: running a quick tail on GPU hosts: `for h in $(cat hosts.txt); do ssh $h sudo journalctl -u inference -n 200 | grep -i latency; done`
Maria: noticed elevated queue length on worker-pool-4. Running `kubectl describe hpa embeddings-prod` shows targeted replicas at 4 but pods are NotReady due to liveness probe failures.
Rahul: @Liam can you validate if KV cache thrash is happening? Last time, cold KV cache led to similar 95p blips.
Liam: good call. Looking at cache hit rates: `curl -s http://metrics/api | jq '.kv_cache.hit_rate'` -> 0.41 (historical ~0.92). That's a big regression.
Sam: filing a ticket for follow-up actions: INF-3421 created to track root-cause, tagging infra and runtime. Link: https://issue-tracker/INF-3421
Nina: rolling one pod at a time per runbook (runbook link: https://runbooks/redwood/embeddings-cache-restart). per-runbook snippet: ```
# rolling restart
kubectl rollout restart deploy/embeddings-prod -n inference
sleep 30
kubectl wait --for=condition=available deploy/embeddings-prod -n inference --timeout=120s
```
Maria: doing canary restart on worker-pool-4 now (pods 0 and 1). marking in channel when complete.
Maria: pod-0 restart succeeded, pod-1 failed liveness. collecting pod logs: `kubectl logs pod-1 -n inference` shows `OOMKilled` around 22:05 UTC.
Liam: OOMs line up with the latency window. lowering batch size on pool-4 to prevent memory spikes. Applying patch: `kubectl patch deploy embeddings-prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","env":[{"name":"MAX_BATCH_TOKENS","value":"4096"}]}]}}}}'`
oncall-bot: ACTION: applied env change to embeddings-prod MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=4096 — config rollout started.
Sam: customer impact assessment: 3 customer errors reported (Customer-A, Customer-B, internal alerting). No data loss. Escalation to account team sent for Customer-A (they hit 504s).
Nina: monitoring shows hit_rate improving to 0.68 after the restart and env change. 95p latency down to ~430ms.
Liam: good. I'm handing off at 23:00 UTC in 15 mins. Maria will be primary from 23:00-07:00 UTC. Leaving the following notes: 1) INF-3421 tracks RCA and memory limits; 2) watch worker-pool-4 for OOM; 3) if latency climbs >700ms, promote fallback model variant `embed-lite-v2` via routing policy. Command: `curl -XPOST https://api-routing/rollout -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","variant":"embed-lite-v2","percent":100}'` (use credentials in vault).
Maria: acknowledged. I'll take primary at 23:00. I'll follow up with a post-handoff checklist: a) escalate INF-3421 to infra-owner, b) schedule 1-hour retro tomorrow, c) check node memory pressure hourly for next 12h.
Rahul: I'll own the retro facilitation. Proposed slot: 2026-03-17 15:00 UTC. I'll create a calendar invite and add action item tracker.
Sam: filing a short postmortem ticket: PM-1289 created for a 1-pager and RCA. Link: https://issue-tracker/PM-1289
Maria: post-handoff quick items logged in INF-3421: `- increase pod memory limit to 20Gi for pool-4` `- add KV cache warmup on restart` `- add alert for kv_cache.hit_rate < 0.7`
Liam: handoff done — leaving the bridge. Ping me if it flares. :thumbsup:
Maria: thanks — I'll monitor through the night. tagging @oncall-bot to watch 95p latency and kv_cache.hit_rate thresholds.
oncall-bot: MONITORING: synthetic-slo-check created, will post updates if 95p latency > 600ms for 5m.
Rahul: follow-up tasks assigned: [INF-3421], [PM-1289]. Retro invite pending.
Sam: closing the immediate incident thread. Final status: mitigated, partial customer impact (timeouts), remediation work in INF-3421.
Maria: quick note for whoever takes over next day: check the A/B routing logs for embed-lite-v2 rollout fallback; we temporarily considered it but did not route traffic yet.
Nina: adding runbook improvement note — include memory OOM checklist and exact `kubectl` patch commands.
Maria: last check at 23:45 UTC — 95p latency stable at ~420ms, kv_cache.hit_rate 0.82. Leaving oncall to night shift.
Rahul: logged retro time and created agenda draft. Thanks team.
Maria: night all.
